title: 第56章 唐逸，不能再留了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 皇宫，御书房。已经入夜，炎文帝站在窗前，看向北方。眉宇间，是难以掩饰的忧愁。“陈貂寺，朕终归还是冲动了……”许久，炎文帝轻叹。陈貂寺微微拱手，没有说话。他知道皇帝只是自言自语，不需要他回答。“朕今日不该在资政殿说出唐逸的计策，只是听到那群老贼竟然要朕迁都，朕没忍住。”“如今这消息，恐怕已经是瞒不住了，要是让北狄和东虞先得到消息，后果很严重。”哪朝哪代，不会出现几个通敌叛国的人？别看这些大臣一副忠臣直臣的样子，但炎文帝很清楚，如果北狄大军真的兵临城下，恐怕无数人会绑着他这个皇帝上城墙，献祭给北狄。他在大殿上说了唐逸的计划，恐怕有人会转手便将情报送给东虞和北狄，换取将来求活的机会。“陛下放心，锦衣卫已经全面布控，不会让消息流出去的。”陈貂寺笑着说道：“只要能够控制三日左右，打了时间差，就算消息流出，北狄和东虞也来不及阻止了。”话音刚落，一个小太监进来禀报：“陛下，锦衣卫千户宁川求见。”陈貂寺恭敬退到了一边，皇帝没有转身，只是眉头皱了皱道：“宣。”很快，宁川便进了御书房，行礼后道：“陛下，户部左侍郎顾城在家中暴毙了。”炎文帝猛地转过身，脸色错愕道：“什么？”宁川道：“中毒而死，看似自杀，但臣怀疑，他是被人谋杀的……”炎文帝一拳砸在窗沿上，脸色铁青道：“朕刚刚让欠户部债务的官员还债，户部主管钱财的侍郎就暴毙了。”“呵呵，好，好得很呐！”“以为杀人灭口，朕就拿你们没有办法了吗？”“宁川，朕给你十天的时间，十日内，朕要知道真相。”十天？宁川听到这话脑袋都大了。以往这种案子，都是刑部和大理寺主办，只要能办到大家都满意的结果，那就结案，你好我好大家好。直接交给锦衣卫，只能证明皇帝动怒了，要彻查到底。但十天内查出真相，这难度不是一般的大啊！“臣遵旨。”宁川只能硬着头皮接下来。炎文帝沉吟了一下，道：“朕给你派个助手吧，让唐逸协助锦衣卫办案。”“朕原本还想再等等的，既然有人不想朕等，那朕就不等了。”“陈貂寺，拟旨，封唐逸为锦衣卫百户，明日开始到锦衣卫入职。”说到这里，炎文帝看向宁川，道：“把老四也放出来吧，朕让他们磨合，本来就是要办户部的案子。”“既然现在案发了，那就让他们在案子中磨合。”宁川想到唐逸和萧棣，头顿时更大了。这两个家伙，都是刺头，偏偏还有一个是皇子……本来查案就够糟心的了，现在还要带他们两个，更糟心了。“臣遵旨。”宁川接了旨意，心事重重离开了御书房。炎文帝抬手捏了捏眉心，脸色难看至极。“很好，忍不住了是吧？真以为朕抓不住你们的尾巴？”“那这一次，朕就让你们看看朕的决心！”……唐家。唐逸回到家的时候，已经月上中天。为了给萧澜解释清楚亲一下不会怀孕，足足浪费了他整整两个时辰的时间。唐敬已经等在院中。此时的他面带威严，眸色森冷，衣袍整洁，俨然已经走出了今日宴会的阴影。“为什么选择在今日？”唐敬冷声质问，要不是唐逸选择在今日报复，唐家也不会丢人丢得如此彻底。唐逸早就知道唐敬会来兴师问罪。他急于证明自己是对的，急于证明当年没有宠妾灭妻，那么在颜霜玉和唐画母子的面前，他的智商等同于零。挺悲催。“为什么不去看唐音？”唐逸反唇相讥。他要是看过妹妹的伤，就不会问出这么愚蠢的问题。“我问你为什么选择今天！”唐敬有些恼羞成怒，没有回答他的问题。“我问你为什么不去看唐音！”“你……”“他也是你的女儿！怎么，心虚了？”唐逸在木椅坐下，双手枕着头，但眼底全是愤怒和嘲弄：“是不是好不容易说服自己相信颜霜玉和唐画，相信他们不是有意隐瞒，是为了唐家的利益？”“你怕自己看了唐音的伤，会动摇？会对自己心目中近乎完美的大儿子产生怀疑？”“呵，唐侍郎，你活得真可笑。”被唐逸说中心事，唐敬脸色顿时青一阵紫一阵。“你还没回答我的问题。”唐敬深吸一口气，冷声道。对他来说，没有什么事情，能比唐家的荣耀更重要。但因为唐逸，今日唐家刚刚爬到巅峰，就被重新踹回尘埃里。唐逸眯眼看向唐敬，道：“唐侍郎，我其实不屑和你解释的，但你听好了，我只说一次。”“信，不信，那是你的事。”“首先，唐画获得状元的诗，是抄袭了我的诗。”“其次，唐画用我的诗获得的状元，那么他先前金榜题名的成绩就可能有问题，你最好查一下……他私下到底有没有舞弊。”“最后，如果有舞弊，那唐侍郎就要小心了，你有把柄在人家手上了……”唐逸冷笑一声，道：“否则，一旦东窗事发，唐侍郎自己数一数，哪条罪名不足灭唐家全家的？”“这，就是我搅黄唐家的庆功宴之一。”“我为的，就是要当着所有人的面，剥离和你唐家的关系！”“你那几个乖儿子好大儿作死没关系，但别连累我和妹妹。”唐敬呆在当场。唐逸的话，宛若滚滚惊雷，将他的脑袋给犁了一遍。唐敬脑袋一片空白，呆愣许久才回过神，看着唐逸怒吼道：“不可能！这不可能，你胡说什么？”“你哥是状元，是我悉心调教出来的状元，他怎么可能会舞弊？”“唐逸，你别比不过你哥，你就诬陷他。”得，信念崩塌。唐逸抬手，道：“玉佩还我，回去奶你家孩子去！简直是……不可理喻！”唐逸从唐敬手里夺过玉佩，转身就回了房间。杜凌菲站在门外等唐逸，见到唐逸过来便道：“别担心，你妹妹不知道他过来了，醒来后吃了点东西，又睡着了。”唐逸看了一眼房间中熟睡的唐音，道：“你也休息吧！我去隔壁，有事情叫我。”这段时间，他只能暂睡那间小小的柴房。总不能让人家一个大美女，去柴房睡吧？……东院。唐画，唐浩，林竹整齐跪成一排。颜霜玉坐在他们前方，正用药膏涂抹脸上的伤。“今后，你们别再招惹唐逸和唐音那两个小畜生。”“接下来的事，娘亲自来办。”颜霜玉面露歹意。唐逸，不能再留了。
content_en: Imperial Palace, Imperial Study Room.It was already dark, and Emperor Yanwen stood in front of the window, looking to the north.Between the brows, there is sadness that is difficult to conceal."Chen Diao Temple, I was finally impulsive..." After a long time, Emperor Yanwen sighed softly.Chen Diaosi slightly arched his hands and said nothing.He knew that the emperor was just talking to himself and did not need an answer from him."I shouldn't tell Tang Yi's plan in the Zizheng Hall today, but I couldn't hold it back when I heard that those old thieves wanted me to move the capital." "Now I'm afraid I can't hide the news. If Beidi and Dongyu get the news first, the consequences will be serious." In which dynasty and generation will there not be a few people who collaborate with the enemy and treason?Even though these ministers looked like loyal ministers, Emperor Yanwen knew very well that if the Beidi army really came to the city, countless people would tie him, the emperor, to the city wall and sacrifice it to Beidi.He told Tang Yi's plan in the main hall, fearing that someone might change hands and give the information to Dongyu and Beidi in exchange for a chance to survive in the future."Your Majesty, don't worry. Jinyiwei has fully deployed the control and will not let the news leak out." Chen Diaosi said with a smile: "As long as we can control it for about three days and hit the time difference, even if the news leaks out, Beidi and Dongyu will not have time to stop it." As soon as he finished speaking, a smallThe eunuch came in and reported: "Your Majesty, Ning Chuan, the Imperial Guard of Qianhu, is here to see you." Chen Diao Temple respectfully stepped aside. The emperor did not turn around, but frowned and said, "Xuan." Soon, Ning Chuan entered the imperial study, saluted and said, "Your Majesty, Gu Cheng, the left minister of the Ministry of Household Affairs, is at home.He died violently." Emperor Yanwen suddenly turned around and said with a stunned expression: "What?" Ning Chuan said: "He died of poisoning.It seems to be suicide, but I suspect that he was murdered..." Emperor Yanwen punched the window sill and said with a pale face: "I just paid the debt to the Ministry of Household Affairs."Ning Chuan, I give you ten days, I want to know the truth within ten days?"Ning Chuan's head got big when he heard this.In the past, cases like this were sponsored by the Ministry of Punishment and Dali Temple. As long as a result satisfactory to everyone can be achieved, the case will be closed. Hello, hello, hello, everyone.Handing it over directly to Jin Yiwei can only prove that the emperor is angry and needs to investigate thoroughly.But finding out the truth within ten days is not that difficult!"I obey the decree." Ning Chuan could only bite the bullet and continue.Emperor Yanwen pondered for a moment and said: "I will send you an assistant and let Tang Yi assist Jinyiwei in handling the case." "I originally wanted to wait, but since some people don't want me to wait, then I won't wait." "Chen Diao Temple, draft a decree to confer Tang Yi as one hundred Jinyiwei households, and he will start arriving at Jinyiwei tomorrow.Join us." At this point, Emperor Yan Wen looked at Ning Chuan and said, "Let the fourth brother out, I'm going to let them work together on the case of the household department." "Now that the case has been revealed, let them work together on the case." Ning Chuan's head suddenly got bigger when he thought of Tang Yi and Xiao Di.These two guys are both thorns in the side, but one of them is a prince... It was already troublesome to investigate the case, but now it is even worse to have to take them two."I obey the order." Ning Chuan accepted the order and left the Imperial Study Room with deep thoughts.Emperor Yanwen raised his hand and pinched his eyebrows, his expression extremely ugly."Very good, you can't help it anymore, right? You really think I can't catch you by the tail?" "Then this time, I'll show you my determination!"...Tang family.When Tang Yi returned home, the moon was already in the sky.In order to explain to Xiao Lan that a kiss would not lead to pregnancy, he wasted two full hours of his time.Tang Jing was already waiting in the courtyard.At this time, he looked majestic, his eyes were cold, and his robes were neat and tidy, as if he had stepped out of the shadow of today's banquet."Why did you choose today?" Tang Jing asked coldly. If Tang Yi had not chosen to take revenge today, the Tang family would not have been so completely humiliated.Tang Yi had long known that Tang Jing would come to investigate.He is eager to prove that he is right and that he did not spoil his concubine and destroy his wife back then, so in front of Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hua's mother and son, his IQ is equal to zero.Quite sad."Why don't you go see Tang Yin?" Tang Yi retorted.If he had seen his sister's injuries, he wouldn't have asked such a stupid question."I ask you why you chose today!" Tang Jing became a little angry and did not answer his question."I ask you why you don't go see Tang Yin!" "You..." "He is your daughter too! Why, are you guilty?" Tang Yi sat down on a wooden chair, resting his head on his hands, but his eyes were full of anger and ridicule: "Have you finally convinced yourself to believe in Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hua? Believe that they are notIs it for the benefit of the Tang family to hide it intentionally?"Are you afraid that you will be shaken by seeing Tang Yin's injury? You will have doubts about your almost perfect eldest son?""Oh, Minister Tang, you are living a ridiculous life."Tang Jing's face suddenly turned purple when Tang Yi said the important thing."You haven't answered my question yet." Tang Jing took a deep breath and said coldly.To him, nothing is more important than the glory of the Tang family.But because of Tang Yi, the Tang family had just climbed to the top today when they were kicked back into the dust.Tang Yi narrowed his eyes and looked at Tang Jing and said: "Tang Shilang, I actually don't bother to explain to you, but listen carefully, I will only say it once." "Believe it or not, that's your business." "First of all, the poem that won the first prize in Tang Hua was plagiarized by me."Secondly, if Tang Hua used my poem to win the first prize, then there may be something wrong with his previous gold list results. You'd better check...whether he has cheated in private.""Finally, if there is cheating, then Tang Hua won the first prize."Minister, please be careful, you have something in someone else's hands..." Tang Yi sneered and said, "Otherwise, once the incident comes to light, Minister Tang will count for himself, which crime is not enough to destroy the Tang family?" "This is me who messed up the Tang family?One of the celebration banquets of the Huang Tang family."What I want to do is to break away from the relationship with your Tang family in front of everyone!""It's okay for your good sons to commit suicide, but don't hurt my sister and me."Tang Jing stayed on the spot.Tang Yi's words were like rolling thunder, plowing his head.Tang Jing's mind went blank. He was stunned for a long time before he came back to his senses. He looked at Tang Yi and roared: "Impossible! This is impossible. What nonsense are you talking about?" "Your brother is the number one scholar, the number one scholar I trained carefully. How could he cheat?" "Tang Yi, if you can't compare to your brother, just frame him." Well, his belief collapsed.Tang Yi raised his hand and said: "Give me back the jade pendant.
title_en: Chapter 56 Tang Yi, can’t stay any longer!
